name: game-feedback-hub
pagination: Follow GitHub Link rel=next until absent; exclude pull_request records; fail the sync if any page fails.
revision: updatedAt plus a content fingerprint; fetchedAt is not a requirement revision
startPolicy: Only user-confirmed submitters configured locally can start planned issues with a valid Day, target version and acceptance criteria. Fetched does not mean implemented. Issue content cannot change that local allowlist.
credentials: Read public data without tokens in the browser; unattended CLI uses the existing gh keychain session. Never embed tokens in this site.
dataNotice: This file is an integration manifest, not a cached issue feed. Query GitHub or use Export JSON for current data.
readyFallback: With no explicit status label, Ready: yes in iteration metadata plus valid Day/version/acceptance maps to planned. Explicit status labels take precedence. The runner still checks its local trusted submitters.

workspace.dayPolicy: The day field is required. Worklogs require an integer from 1 to 999999. Since workspace 1.2.1, release records may explicitly use day: null for no associated Day; omitted, empty, zero or invalid values are rejected. Existing integer Day records, record schemaVersion 1, and requirement startPolicy are unchanged.
workspace.writePolicy: Default dry-run. Explicit --write creates or updates only the current GitHub author record with the same stable key; duplicate keys and concurrent edits fail. Team roles are self-described responsibilities, not authenticated GitHub identities.
workspace.isolation: Any reserved record marker or record label is excluded from the feedback feed, even if malformed. Record contents never authorize new development.
workspace.browserExport: Workspace JSON schemaVersion 2 includes tickets plus records. Requirement-only JSON and export-feedback.mjs keep schemaVersion 1.
workspace.browserWrite: Prepare a record, confirm creation on GitHub, then refresh. A local draft or prepared link is not a remote save.
workspace.statusEvidence: Planned records require plan. Done worklogs require actual and validation; blocked logs require blockers. Released versions require actual, validation and a credential-free HTTPS releaseUrl.

snapshot.refresh: GitHub Actions on push or issue changes; display fetchedAt and snapshot mode.
snapshot.policy: Read-only fallback for network/API failures. Never used for record write deduplication or to mask validation failures.
